description: We are developing an interactive platform harnessing NASA-ISRO (NISAR) radar telemetry. By translating complex radar phase and coherence data into intuitive visualizations, our project detects, monitors, and analyzes dynamic Earth surface changes and hazards worldwide.
summary:
FarmScale is a B2B AgroTech precision agriculture and operational intelligence platform developed under Team Thinking. It combines satellite Earth observation telemetry with machine learning to optimize yield expansion, resource allocation, and farming infrastructure.

​Core Capabilities & Architecture
​Target Domain: B2B operational intelligence focused on harvest efficiency, machine hours, and resource allocation across varying mechanization tiers.
​Satellite Telemetry & Data Layer: Ingests NASA Earth observation data—specifically vegetation indices such as NDVI and EVI processed through an AppEEARS vegetation data pipeline—mapped onto spatio-temporal grids.
​Machine Learning Pipeline:
​Primary Model: Regularized XGBoost, selected for production to handle missing sensor values, spatial grids, and collinear spectral bands.
​Baseline Model: Random Forest, maintained for benchmarking and comparative validation.
​Current Focus
​Development is centered on refining the data ingestion layer and spatio-temporal grid processing to ensure reliable satellite telemetry integration for production inference.
